label: copy-phase echo of r (and i), mid-sequence
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, when the fed-back input is a repeat of an earlier token (in_first=0, so always an echo of an original token). Never fires in the original phase or at <DEL>. It is input-token selective: r holds 57% of activation mass (15x lift) and i holds 27% (9x). l and m add about 5% each, with a weak tail on 2, a and o. The strongest activations (up to max) are r echoes at recall_idx 2-3, i.e. the 2nd-3rd original token being fed back, with several outputs still to go. It rarely fires at recall_idx 1 or in the last 1-2 copy steps (to_go 0-1). Even under these conditions only about half of r/i echoes fire, and checks on first-occurrence, absolute t, and other history variables did not separate the firing cases from the silent ones. Dev: P 0.49, R 0.63, F1 0.55, mass recall 0.74.
